name: Clonazolam
summary: A long lasting benzodiazepine with heavily hypnotic effects. The safety profile is not well established, there have been reports that people taking it three days in a row have had a seizure. Most comparable to Triazolam, but with a much longer half-life.

tolerance.buildUp: within a couple of days of continuous use

pharmacology.text: Clonazolam's effects are similar to other benzodiazepines, such as anxiolysis, disinhibition, lethargy, muscle relaxation, and euphoria.

uses.text: Although little research has been done about its effects and metabolism, it is sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: It causes strong sedation, memory loss and blackouts, poor coordination and lowered inhibitions. It is extremely potent, so it is easy to take too much by accident, and overdose can slow breathing dangerously. Regular use quickly leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause severe withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成強烈鎮靜、失憶與斷片、協調變差及抑制力降低。它的效力極強，很容易不小心用過量，過量時可能危險地抑制呼吸。規律使用很快就會產生依賴，突然停藥可能引發包括癲癇發作在內的嚴重戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成强烈镇静、失忆与断片、协调制差及抑制力降低。它的效力极强，很容易不小心用过量，过量时可能危险地抑制呼吸。规律使用很快就会产生依赖，突然停药可能引发包括癫痫发作在内的严重戒断反应。

fact.en: Clonazolam combines the nitro group of clonazepam with the triazole ring of alprazolam and triazolam. It was first described by chemists at Upjohn in the early 1970s but was never sold as a medicine.
fact.zh: 科納唑侖結合了氯硝西泮的硝基，以及阿普唑侖和三唑侖的三唑環。它在 1970 年代初期由普強藥廠的化學家首次描述，但從未作為藥物上市。
fact.zhHans: 科纳唑仑结合了氯硝西泮的硝基，以及阿普唑仑和三唑仑的三唑环。它在 1970 年代初期由普强药厂的化学家首次描述，但从未作为药物上市。
